description.content: Searches for items across all available catalogs using a keyword. Unlike the per-catalog `/Items` endpoint, this endpoint searches across all catalogs in a single request and returns a paginated list of matching items.

query.description: Keyword to search for across all catalog item fields (name, description, manufacturer, etc.). If omitted, all items across all catalogs are returned.
Number of items to return per page. Defaults to 100.
Page number to retrieve (1-based). Use with `PageSize` to paginate through large result sets.

variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier for the partner account.

response.name: A paginated list of catalog item objects matching the search.

variable.description: (Required) Unique identifier for the partner account.

description.content:
Catalogs are product feeds provided by brands that contain item-level details such as pricing, images, descriptions, and availability. Partners can use catalogs to build dynamic product listings and deep-link directly to specific products.

 Name: impact.com Developer Support
 Email: support@impact.com
